summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that on October 6, 2026, subsidiary Vertical Aerospace Group Ltd. filed a patent-infringement counterclaim against Archer Aviation Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, alleging Archer's eVTOL Midnight aircraft infringes U.S. Patent No. 12,747,027. The counterclaim responds to Archer's February 23, 2026 suit (Civil Action No. 2:26-cv-00149-JRG) against the Company and VAGL, and seeks injunctive relief plus monetary damages. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership change are stated; this is litigation disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for injunction rulings and damages milestones.
